kernel_panic.if_unreachable: Node unavailable -- BIOS/serial console history for this event may only exist in the centralized Elastic sol-*/bmcjournal-* pipeline outside NEXUS's reach; recommend requesting log export from that system if available.

mce_mca.if_unreachable: Node likely down due to fatal MCE/IERR -- only crashdump/ITP capture or the centralized log pipeline may have pre-failure evidence; NEXUS cannot retroactively fetch it via SSH.

bios_boot.if_unreachable: BIOS serial console capture at time of failure is NOT retroactively obtainable via SSH. This requires either the ticket's own attached SOL capture, or the centralized Elastic sol-* pipeline (outside NEXUS's access) captured live during the event.

bmc_management.if_unreachable: BMC access is independent of host OS reachability -- collection depends only on configured BMC network access and credentials.
bmc_management.note: BMC access is independent of host OS reachability -- evidence may still be retrievable when the host is down.

unknown_generic.if_unreachable: Node unavailable -- no direct SSH evidence could be collected. Centralized Elastic sol-*/qpool-*/eventlog-*/bmcjournal-* indices are outside NEXUS's direct collection scope.
